scope: Current-desktop controlled software raster, source preparation and exact original-data queries. Not compositor frame/present, hardware qualification, official-runtime parity or long-soak acceptance.

formal.dropPolicy: No silently omitted requests. Drain planned requests; retain actual duration, lateness, failures and timeout evidence.

development.description: Short development observations must not satisfy or replace the formal five-process/100-fresh-process campaign.

barGeometry.overlapContract: Returned original bar must geometrically intersect the query tolerance after plot clipping. Overlapping bars need not uniquely identify the arbitrarily probed source column.

quality.sameStateRasterRestoration: When the final query revision is even and its full range equals the initial first-use range, require exact decoded first/last PNG pixel equality. A different final state is not an equal-quality restoration proof.

metrics.p99Qualification: Descriptive observed quantile; sample counts and independent-process counts accompany it, not a proven tail-latency SLA.
metrics.controlledRaster: Synchronous RenderTargetBitmap.Render only; PNG encoding, file IO, pixel copy and hashing are outside this interval.
metrics.firstUse: Before source assignment to a new chart through same-revision controlled raster completion and successful original-point query. External source materialization/hash is measured separately.
metrics.threadAllocation: Current UI-thread synchronous intervals only; not total process/render-thread/native/GPU allocation.
metrics.memoryEndpoints: Before/after observations only; not an actual sampled process peak, retained-growth curve or native/GPU accounting.
metrics.millionPointHitTail: deferred-by-user; original-data correctness checks remain required
metrics.firstUseNominalSoftwareDiagnosticQualifi: Descriptive controlled-raster diagnostic only. It is not the frozen firstUsableToRender frame-pipeline target and cannot declare that target passed.
metrics.peakProcessPrivateQualification: Not evaluated from endpoints or cumulative working-set high-water marks. Requires matching empty-host baseline and comparable sampled process peak measurement.
